issues: TypeScript compilation fails: tsc reports an error "Option 'moduleResolution=node10' has been removed" (tsconfig.json line 11). This originates from a tsconfig in a dependency (e.g., node_modules) that uses the deprecated value. The project tsconfig must be updated to avoid importing or processing this config or the offending option must be removed.

Accessibility checks report serious color‑contrast failures on both phone and desktop first‑page UI. Some text/background color combinations (e.g., button labels, links, or UI text) do not meet WCAG minimum contrast ratios. The theme colors need adjustment (e.g., darker primary or higher‑contrast text colors) or UI component styles must be updated to ensure all visible text meets contrast thresholds.

Primary UI flow test fails: the test cannot click the "Don’t have an account? Sign up" link on the Sign‑In screen (timeout). The link is implemented as a TouchableOpacity with accessibilityRole="link" and an accessibilityLabel, but the testing tool does not recognize it as a clickable link. Adjust the component (e.g., use a Pressable/Text with proper role/aria‑label, ensure it renders as an anchor on web, or add a testID) so the link can be located and activated by the flow test.
feedback: The backend passes the acceptance tests, but the frontend does not meet the static validation checks. Fix the TypeScript configuration error, improve color contrast for accessibility, and make the sign‑up navigation link discoverable for automated UI flow testing. Once these issues are resolved and static validation passes, the solution can be approved.
